title: fix(plugin-form): the drawer, modal, split, tabbed and wizard layouts re-read their record on the data-invalidation bus (objectui#10715)
body:
Fixes #10715
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`), from claim comment 5852488194 on objectui#10715, executing triage 5851645899. Branch `claude/issue-10715-form-arms-invalidation-bus`, cut from `origin/main` `5ad3b888` (BASE); head `03579ea0`.

## What changed

`object-form` routes its `formType` to six layouts, and only the default arm (`SimpleObjectForm` in `ObjectForm.tsx`) read the data-invalidation bus (`useDataInvalidation` from `@object-ui/react`, objectui#10572). `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`, `SplitForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm` kept the record as first read after `notifyDataChanged`. The pending changeset `10572-plugin-form-reads-invalidation-bus.md` says `object-form` in edit mode re-reads; this PR makes that true of every `formType`.

- New `packages/plugin-form/src/recordInvalidation.ts`: `useRecordInvalidation(objectName, recordId, readsRecord)` states the rule once — the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for the record's object, the record itself, or `'*'`; the pristine gate; one held re-read replayed on `onDirtyChange(false)` or `saved()`. It returns `refetch` (a counter the record read effect names), `onDirtyChange` and `saved`. The two functions are created once (a `useState` initializer that is never set), so a host may list them in a dependency array without resting on a memo's identity (AGENTS.md #10). Not exported from the package entry.
- `ObjectForm.tsx` (default arm): re-pointed at the helper; its own nonce, dirty and held refs are deleted. Its `inPlace` loading logic is unchanged.
- `DrawerForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`: `handleDirtyChange` feeds both the existing `isDirty` close guard and the bus gate; `recordRefetch` joins the record read effect's dependency array; `recordSaved()` after the write lands.
- `SplitForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx`: the form node gets `onDirtyChange`; `recordRefetch` in the record read effect; `recordSaved()` after the write lands.
- `WizardForm.tsx`: the step form gets `onDirtyChange`, and the wizard folds a second source of unsaved input into the gate — answers merged by `handleStepSubmit` that differ from what the wizard held (`stepValuesDiffer`, the renderer's empty-ish or JSON rule), cleared when a read commits or the save lands; `recordRefetch` in the record read effect; `recordSaved()` after the write lands.
- `recordFormsErrorClears-10682.test.tsx`: its header no longer says the five layouts do not subscribe.
- `.changeset/10715-form-arms-read-invalidation-bus.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-form': patch`.

No prop, export, schema key or dependency moves. `LineItemsPanel.tsx` (objectui#10740, in flight) is untouched.

## H1 — reproduction, base versus head

Probe: `formArmsInvalidation-10715.test.tsx` case (a), through the real `SchemaRenderer` and this package's registration: a good first read, then `notifyDataChanged` for the record's object, for `'*'`, and for the record itself; `findOne` counted.

| Arm (`formType`) | BASE `5ad3b888`: `findOne` after notify | HEAD `03579ea0` |
|---|---|---|
| default arm (no `formType`) — lit control | 2 (probe green) | 2 |
| `drawer` | 1 — `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times` | 2 |
| `modal` | 1 — same assertion | 2 |
| `split` | 1 — same assertion | 2 |
| `tabbed` | 1 — same assertion | 2 |
| `wizard` | 1 — same assertion | 2 |

Base run: `Tests  29 failed | 17 passed (46)` — red: the five arms' (a) three keys, (b), (e), both wizard step pins, both closed drawer and modal pins; green: the default arm's seven and the five arms' (c) and (d) controls. Head run: `Tests  46 passed (46)`.

## H2 — shape

Same hook, same keys, same gate: `useDataInvalidation(objectName, String(recordId))` when `recordId` is set and `mode !== 'create'`; the default arm additionally requires no inline field source, its existing predicate, unchanged. That predicate covers view mode as the default arm's always has; the order's "edit mode only" was read as "not create mode", which is what the default arm does. The shared helper is extracted and the default arm re-pointed at it, so the rule is stated once. The re-read goes through each arm's existing record read effect (`recordRefetch` in its dependency array), so the objectui#10712 `cancelled` guard covers it, and the loading branch — keyed on `loadedRecordIdRef.current !== schema.recordId` on the five, on `inPlace` on the default arm — is not entered. Measured, case (e): two notifies in separate acts issue reads 2 and 3; read 3 answered first, read 2 answered last: the screen keeps read 3 on all six arms.

## H3 — edges

- Create mode: `findOne` is 0 before and after notify on all six, case (d).
- Another object (`some_other_object`) and another record (`deal`, `r2`): `findOne` stays 1 on all six, case (c).
- Wizard, two steps, edit mode: type on step 1, Next, on step 2, two notifies: `findOne` stays 1, `Step 2 of 2` stays, the step-2 input is unchanged; Update: the payload carries the step-1 answer, `ifMatch` is the original token, then exactly one held re-read (`findOne` 2). Next with nothing typed is pristine: notify, `findOne` 2, `Step 2 of 2` stays, the same step-2 input node shows the server's new value. A re-read never touches `currentStep`: the wizard's read effect writes `formData` and `persistedRecord` only.
- Closed drawer and modal (`open: false`): the layout component stays mounted and its record read effect runs, so it reads while closed (`findOne` 2 after notify, nothing drawn), and opening (`open: true`) draws the fresh values with no further read (`findOne` stays 2). Stated from the code, not pinned: a drawer or modal closed while dirty keeps `isDirty`, so a change while closed is held and replays when the reopened renderer emits `onDirtyChange(false)`.

## Pins and ablations

`packages/plugin-form/src/formArmsInvalidation-10715.test.tsx`, 46 cases: per arm (a) three keys, (b) dirty control with save and one replay, (c) other object and other record, (d) create, (e) superseded re-read; two wizard step pins; two closed drawer and modal pins. Red on base (29), green on head (46), as above.

Per-arm ablation with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from `../objectstack` (WRAP mode); mutation: drop `recordRefetch` from that arm's record read effect dependency array. ## H5 — published prose

- `.changeset/10572-plugin-form-reads-invalidation-bus.md`: 「`object-form` in edit mode re-reads its record when the data-invalidation bus … reports a change to that record, its object, or everything」 is true as written of every `formType` at head; no dated note needed.
- `git grep` over `.changeset/*.md` for the five arm names next to the bus: only `10682-form-error-clears.md` mentions the bus, and only for the default layout (「Since objectui#10572 the default layout also re-reads…」), still true. No pending changeset says the five do not read it.

## Serial

After the final push: `git fetch origin main:refs/private/issue-10715/main -f` shows main moved from `5ad3b888` to `01700dcd7d` (37 files), none under `packages/plugin-form` or this changeset; `git merge-tree --write-tree refs/private/issue-10715/main HEAD` exit 0 (clean). No merge commit needed.

## Acceptance notes

- Reading while closed (drawer and modal) is a consequence of the shared shape, not a gate of its own: the layout components subscribe like any other mounted reader. Holding while closed and replaying on open would need a per-layout `isOpen` gate; not done here.
- The wizard's unsaved-steps rule compares each step's submitted answers by value with the renderer's empty-ish or JSON rule, so Next through an untouched step keeps the wizard pristine. A widget that normalises a value differently from the record (a `null` for the record's `''`, say) reads as an unsaved answer and holds the re-read until save — the conservative direction.
- objectui#10712 remains open (its PR 2, `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, sits in `pm:queue`); objectui#10740 holds `LineItemsPanel.tsx` and is not touched here.
- Carrier: none. No out-of-scope finding is filed from this card.
